description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is a fundamental component for a logging system in an Android application. It specifies a method for outputting log data, which can be implemented in various ways to facilitate logging to different targets or formats.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log information and potentially chaining to other nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exceptions.
